name: Trellis
description: Your Trellis boards and vault as a panel: cards, claims, comments and entries, updated live as they change elsewhere; hand a card to an agent from the board, by sending it to one already running or starting a new one, and see which agent works on it; a skill that teaches those agents the card commands; open and claimed cards per workspace, and a notice that opens the card when an agent moves it to review or blocked.
